lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnCuO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms (Mn₄Cu₄O₁₂) across seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral coordination with six O neighbors, while Cu adopts a tetrahedral environment with four O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Mn octahedra and Cu tetrahedra, as well as edge-sharing among Mn octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
